ads.headline: A Surgeon's Answer To Wrinkles
ads.body:
The question a plastic surgeon gets asked most: what do I do about lines if I don't want a procedure?

111SKIN founder Dr Yannis Alexandrides answers it in full. The short version is an overnight, needle-free fix you can do at home. Wrinkle Erasing Retinol Patches use microcone technology to deliver active ingredients twice as deep as topical skincare, targeting frown lines, forehead lines and crow's feet while you sleep.

Covered by Marie Claire. Loved by customers, celebrities and editors.

ads.transcript: As a plastic surgeon, one of the most frequently asked questions I receive from patients is about the best solution for deep set lines and wrinkles. But if surgery or aesthetic treatments is not a solution for you, you should try 111SKIN's Wrinkle Erasing Retinol Patches. It's an overnight needle-free fix that you can try at home to precisely target frown lines, forehead lines, crow's feet and nasolabial folds. The Wrinkle Erasing Retinol Patches use microcone technology to deliver active ingredients twice as deep as topical skincare. It's no surprise then that they have become quickly a five-star favorite by customers, beloved by celebrities and editors including Harper's Bazaar, Vogue, Glamour and many more.

Backstage Skin Edit: Cleansing Oil, Precision Peel, Black Diamond Essence, Celestial Black Diamond Eye Mask, Y Theorem Bio Cellulose Mask, Black Diamond Serum, Black Diamond Contour Gel, Black Diamond Emulsion, All Day Radiance Mist
ads.transcript: Come with me backstage at the Proenta Schooler Spring Summer 2027 show, where I let the skin prep with 111 Skin. For the skin this season, I envisioned a woman who puts in the maximum effort to achieve maximum results, an ethos I feel 111 Skin embodies perfectly. I designed the facial around the Black Diamond Collection, an opulent range of concentrated, high-performance formulas designed to intensely preserve, restore, and renew the complexion. I prepped the skin with the 111 Skin Cleansing Oil and All Day Radiance Face Mist before applying the Black Diamond Essence and Serum. Then, to achieve the maximum radiance to the skin, I applied the Celestial Black Diamond Eye Mask and layered over the Y Theorem Biolaceous Mask. I focused a lot on sculpting the skin with my signature facial massage, as well as using the 111 Skin Cryoglobes on the face to de-puff, sculpt, and soothe the skin. Just like a Black Diamond, I wanted the skin to reflect light with brilliant shine and unparalleled radiance while maintaining a smooth, refined, and flawless-looking complexion. And with this precise skin prep, the model's skin was infused with hydration, was visibly plumper, and prepped for makeup.
